outcome: Blood loss during and after elective cesarean section
cohort: 124 pregnant women subjected to term elective cesarean section
finding: TA administration during elective cesarean section significantly reduced blood loss, resulted in lower postpartum hemoglobin and hematocrit levels, and had a 30% risk reduction in postpartum blood loss compared to the control group.
mod_finding: Tranexamic acid (TA) reduced blood loss during and immediately after cesarean section.
